question: Where can I find fast food restaurant that falls within 50 kilometers in the direction of travel toward Go Ape Treetop Adventure Course, Strongsville, OH?
sql: SELECT pois.poi_name, pois.addr_state, pois.addr_city FROM pois WHERE pois.amenity = 'fast_food' AND ST_DWithin( pois.geometry, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Go Ape Treetop Adventure Course%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Strongsville%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%OH%' LIMIT 1 )::geography, 50000 ) ORDER BY ST_Distance( pois.geometry, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Go Ape Treetop Adventure Course%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Strongsville%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%OH%' LIMIT 1 )::geography ) ASC;

answers.poi_name: Wallace Lake Bathhouse and Concession Building
